subject.title: fix(qa-lab): report authoritative Crabline readiness artifact

question: Should this protected PR require a completed exact-head QA-lab report showing distinct provider-readiness and smoke artifact paths before merge?
rationale: Automated tests support the change, but repository policy treats after-fix real behavior proof as a merge gate and the dependency-backed legacy fallback has not been directly confirmed in the available evidence.

options.title: Require exact-head report
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted completed QA-lab run visibly reports distinct provider-readiness and smoke paths after the branch is rebased.

options.title: Override after contract review
options.body: Accept the automated fixture as sufficient only after a maintainer directly verifies the Crabline 0.1.11 fallback contract and explicitly overrides the proof gate.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head report
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted completed QA-lab run visibly reports distinct provider-readiness and smoke paths after the branch is rebased.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged predecessor work introduced the exact artifact integration and provides the strongest available history for deciding its proof boundary.
